errors.message: `background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4c6b5a 0%, #7a9484 100%)` is not supported (supported colors: #rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), the 148 CSS color names and transparent)
errors.hint: no gradients: use one solid `background-color` (the picture becomes flat). If the text uses `background-clip: text` with `color: transparent`, drop those too or the text disappears (guide §5)
